title: Fredericton Home Rebates 2026: NB Power Insulation Examples
desc: Fredericton home rebates for 2026: how NB Power's insulation rates add up for attics and basements, plus heat pump, window and HRV rebates. Worked examples from the official rate table.
badge: Insulation pays $0.40 to $3.00 per square foot
lead: Nearly half of Fredericton's homes were built before 1981, so insulation is where many owners will start. NB Power pays by the square foot, and the amount depends on how much R-value you add. This page works through the official table with examples, and lists the other rebates open on October 21, 2026.
cards_heading: What is open for Fredericton homes in 2026
cards_intro: We read the NB Power pages on SaveEnergyNB on October 21, 2026. Each card shows the date and links to the source.

cards.title: Central ducted heat pump
cards.note: On NB Power's qualifying list. $400 for a mini split, $2,000 geothermal, $350 per head multizone.

cards.title: Heat pump water heater
cards.note: ENERGY STAR. Drain water heat recovery pays $400.

cards.title: Insulation
cards.note: By R-value added. Insulate at least 20% of an area.

cards.title: Windows, HRV, air sealing
cards.note: Windows, doors and skylights $50 each, HRV $200, air sealing by leakage drop.

cards.title: Income under $70,000
cards.note: Combined household income under $70,000. First come, first served while funding lasts.

cards.title: Oil to heat pump advance
cards.note: Registration closed June 30, 2026. Finish by March 31, 2027 if you registered.

sections:
The 2021 Census counted 28,475 households in the City of Fredericton.

  • Owners. 57% own and 43% rent.
  • Older homes. About 48% were built before 1981.
  • Kinds of homes. 12,460 households (44%) live in single-detached houses. 9,930 live in apartments in buildings under five storeys, and 2,375 in apartments in a duplex.
  • Income. The median household total income was $73,000 in 2020, and about 48% of households earned under $70,000, the Enhanced program's line.

1,785 homes (6%) needed major repairs.
How the insulation rebate adds up

NB Power pays per square foot by the R-value you add. These examples use the official table and a made-up home size, so they show the method, not your rebate. The rates between the rows are also paid.

JobRate on the tableExample
Attic, add R-40 to 1,000 square feet$0.65 per square foot$650
Attic, add R-60 to 1,000 square feet$0.85 per square foot$850
Basement walls, add R-20 to 600 square feet$1.50 per square foot$900
Basement header, add R-30 to 150 square feet$2.00 per square foot$300

You must insulate at least 20% of the area, and the attic minimum to add is R-15. If you remove mouldy or squashed insulation, you must put back what you took out plus the minimum to add.
Heat pumps and the rest of the list

A central ducted air source heat pump earns $1,500, a mini split $400, and a multizone system $350 per indoor head. A heat pump water heater earns $550. Windows, doors and skylights earn $50 each, a heat recovery ventilator $200, and air sealing $250 to $550 by how much leakage drops. Air sealing does not pay if your home started at 3 air changes per hour or less.

The Total Home Energy Savings Program starts with a Home Energy Evaluation by a Certified Energy Advisor. Register online or call 1-800-663-6272. You have 9 months from the evaluation to finish the work. A final inspection gives you a new EnerGuide rating, and the rebates are paid from your receipts. If your combined household income is under $70,000, ask about the Enhanced Energy Savings Program instead. See our National Heat Pump Rebate guide for the federal rebate expected in early 2027.
claim_steps: Look at your attic and basement first. Older homes lose the most heat there.
Register for Total Home online or call 1-800-663-6272.
Get the Home Energy Evaluation before you buy anything.
Add the insulation, then the heat pump or windows if they make sense.
Keep receipts for the final inspection.
faq: How much does NB Power pay for attic insulation in Fredericton?
$0.40 per square foot at R-15 added, up to $0.85 at R-60. The minimum to add is R-15 and you must insulate at least 20% of the ceiling area.
Is there a heat pump rebate in Fredericton?
Yes. NB Power pays $1,500 for a central ducted heat pump, $400 for a mini split and $2,000 for geothermal, if the unit is on its qualifying list.
Can I get help if my income is under $70,000?
Yes. The Enhanced Energy Savings Program is for homeowners with a combined household income under $70,000. It is first come, first served while funding lasts.
Is the oil to heat pump advance still open in Fredericton?
No. Registration closed on June 30, 2026. People who registered must finish by March 31, 2027.
Does Fredericton have its own home energy rebate?
We found no City of Fredericton home energy rebate on NB Power's pages. The money comes from NB Power's programs.
